name: Feedback fingerprint
purpose: Deterministic 12-hex fingerprint per entry that keys the same-defect fold on issue create.
responsibilities: Compute the first 12 hex characters of sha-256 over the canonical fingerprint input
Exclude blueprint version from the input so a defect across versions folds
Fall back to normalised-title tokens when the anchor is absent, and warn in preview
internalStructure: src/feedback/fingerprint.js is pure and tiny: fingerprint(entry) -> hex12 plus normaliseTitle(title) helper for the fallback.

interfaces.name: fingerprint
interfaces.description: Compute the entry fingerprint from its canonical input.

tradeoffs: A tiny fingerprint (12 hex = 48 bits) risks a collision at very large corpuses; at the scale of a single blueprint tracker it is safe, and issues carry the full-anchor context in the body so a maintainer resolves a rare collision by hand.
notes: The fingerprint appears twice in the body (visible line and HTML comment) so maintainer edits do not lose it.
